name: std-prob-montecarlo
description: Monte-Carlo π engine — ~250 points shimmer in a [-5,5] square; the red inside-circle fraction ≈ π/4 estimates π on math-canvas.

schema.name: std-prob-montecarlo
schema.description: Monte-Carlo π engine — ~250 points shimmer in a [-5,5] square; the red inside-circle fraction ≈ π/4 estimates π on math-canvas.

emits.description: The current point field each tick — a composed listener (π readout, histogram, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: Points Updated
events.description: The current point field each tick — a composed listener (π readout, histogram, mirror canvas) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick re-scatters every point uniformly in the [-5,5] square and recolors it; toggle to start/pause.

points.label: Points
points.description: ~250 samples uniform in the [-5,5] square; red points fall inside the inscribed radius-5 circle, blue outside — the red fraction ≈ π/4.
